steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Je... Jessie... How... how did you...
Facing this "old friend" for whom she has so many complex feelings, Eureka instinctively becomes panicked and timid. Jessie laughs scornfully, her taunting gaze brimming with mockery.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Eureka, you still choose to be a clown instead of realizing your true value. I'm truly disappointed.
What do you know about value? You think your value lies in those things you made?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: A rice cooker that shoots out rice, a bean grinder with a drill... Jessie, did you make those...?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: I remember there was also a young kid in your squad back then. Your captain brought it up.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...But why did you sell them to people who had no idea about their functions? Many innocent people got hurt by them!

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Ha, that's exactly what I want. Aren't these things quite powerful? They lull people into a false sense of security with their harmless appearance, and then unleash the greatest destructive power when they least expect it... This is something I learned from you.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: But I never made inventions to hurt people! And I don't care who is better than who... I just want... I just...

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: You just want to be accepted, right?
Jessie interrupts Eureka's stammering, laughing to herself.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Hehehe... Eureka, Eureka, what should I say about you?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Do you know how many times Uncle told me, "Jessie, be nice to Eureka, we need her." "Jessie, why can't you be as good as her? If only you had half as much talent."

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: It's because he valued your talent so much that he stubbornly believed that even if our philosophies differed, you would eventually join us and become a real partner.
As she speaks, Jessie's expression becomes twisted.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Yet what did you do? You turned your back on his kindness, and even destroyed his factory! When the explosion happened, Uncle didn't make it out of the lab alive because he was trying to save those blueprints... The factory workers were as heartless as you. Once Uncle died, they took all the valuables and ran away!

steps.speaker: Her hot, humid breath sweeps by you. You feel a certain essence slowly leaving your body, and your vision begins to blur!
steps.content: Good thing those buffoons couldn't tell what was truly valuable. I took all the materials contaminated beyond the threshold, and picked up some of your discarded trash... Those appliances were made from stuff I brought out from the factory years ago.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: I will prove to you, to my late uncle, and to everyone in this world, that I've never been inferior to you. I can be better than you!
Eureka ponders for a moment, looking at Jessie with some confusion.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Huh? So, you made those inventions just to prove a point?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Yes. I spent many years creating them. Admit it, those are truly remarkable inventions!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: They are indeed interesting ideas... but there are many problems in the actual execution.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Hmm... let's take that coffee machine for instance. Connecting the power cord to the grinder can indeed generate a reverse power flow when activated, but the amount of electricity produced is too low to be efficient.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Your audio speaker can reach ultra-high decibels, but there are too many amplifiers inside, which can easily malfunction and burn out the circuit.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: And that showerhead flamethrower... it's not easy to control the temperature. The high-temperature steam can cause the pipe to burst and injure the user.
Upon hearing this, the smug look on Jessie's face vanishes. She has no way of refuting Eureka, because all the problems mentioned are indeed present in her inventions.
Eureka scratches her chin and continues.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: So if it were me... I would use the same reverse flow power generation design for a washing machine. I would reduce the number of amplifiers for the speaker and change their layout to achieve the same or even better effect. As for the showerhead flamethrower, I would use two pipes, one for fire and one for water, and apply heat-insulating materials throughout.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: These measures are very easy to think of and convenient to implement. Why haven't you enhanced them further for such a long time?

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Shut up!
Jessie interrupts Eureka, pointing at her indignantly.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: So what if my inventions have flaws? They can still take your life!
As soon as Jessie says this, a thunderous roar erupts from the darkness behind her...
Countless lethal-looking weapons emerge: huge tanks, ammunition drones, mobile turrets, and many other unnameable monstrosities.
...There's so many! How did she manage to secretly tinker with so many illegal weapons without the Public Security Bureau noticing?!
The next second, a shell flies in Eureka's direction.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Oh no!
Eureka screams, but her hands are steady as a rock.
She quickly pulls out a pair of surfboards from her tool bag and stuffs them into her shoe soles, then kicks off, flying out at an incredible speed!
The shell leaves a huge pit where Eureka was standing, but she had already darted behind a large stone slab in the abandoned factory.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Eureka, is there any point in hiding? Even if you burrow into the ground, I can dig you out!

This time, Jessie releases a drone. The drone's wings buzz, emitting an infrared detection line that continuously scans the area. Eureka quickly stuffs some bubble gum into her mouth, chews and spits it out, then loads it onto a slingshot-like launcher.
Whoosh... splat! The drone's camera is covered by bubble gum, completely disabling its surveillance function.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: What... what is this?!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: It's my new invention: a bubble gum launcher! I recycled and refitted it from the Bureau's security system. It has an automatic aiming function!

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Hmph, what random junk... You got lucky this time. There's no way your rubbish can defeat a tank!
Jessie waves her hand, and a heavy tank emerges from the side with a loud roar. It slowly aims its cannon at the stone slab that Eureka is hiding behind.
However, there's still no hint of panic on Eureka's face. She turns her backpack upside down, shaking out a bunch of plastic little frogs.
Ribbit ribbit ribbit ribbit ribbit... The noisy little green fellows hop over the stone slab to the other end and spit out long plastic tongues, stuffing the tank's cannon.
Bang... Kaboom!
The entire tank breaks apart like a misfired gun. Shining metal fragments are blasted into the air, illuminating the sky with spectacular, colorful sparks.
You watch Eureka skillfully "command the battle" from nearby. It's like watching a strange yet breathtaking performance. You can't help but admit that you really underestimated this quirky inventor.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Damn it... what about this? Eureka, you remember this, don't you? You were really scared of it back then.
Eureka purses her lips. On Jessie's thin, scarred arm is the familiar arm-style gun that had haunted her for so many years.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: Over the years, I've modified and upgraded it repeatedly, significantly increasing the bullet capacity and firing speed. This time, even your ridiculous surfboard won't be able to escape my bullets!
What's the matter? Are you worried that you can't handle this gun?
Eureka shakes her head slowly.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: No, Chief, I think I can win. I... I'm just worried that I will lose control of my power again like last time...
You won't, Eureka. I'm here this time.
You give her a comforting and encouraging look. Endless power circulates between the links of the shackles.
I can help suppress your power. Just do what you need to do. Your inventions won't be exploited by others again. They won't become weapons that hurt people again.

A barrage of bullets sweeps towards you like a violent storm. Eureka raises a handheld fan. Backed by her power, the thin fan blades whip up a massive tornado, diverting countless bullets off their course.

The arm-mounted gun emits black smoke after firing its last bullet, loosening from Jessie's arm and falling to the ground. There's nothing left behind Jessie, but she stubbornly bites her lip so hard that it almost bleeds.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: That's impossible, I can't lose...! I've been preparing these things for many years... How could you possibly beat me!

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: It's not over... It's not over yet!

Jessie suddenly changes direction, and throws something with a sparking fuse at you. Eureka's pupils constrict. In that moment, memories flood back like a tidal wave. She sees again the cowering civilians in the underground lab, their faces twisted in their final moments.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Chief!!!

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: A bomb. Another bomb. You think back to the day this all started, in the interrogation room... there was also a bomb. You close your eyes, listening to Eureka's shouts and the sound of her footsteps, but this time, you feel strangely reassured.

steps.speaker: Mini Robot
steps.content: Clack! Clack clack!

A dazzling white light forms a protective shield around you. The sound of the explosion is blocked out, and you feel only a slight impact before quickly regaining your footing. At the same time, you hear sirens in the distance.

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: How could this be... I put in so much effort... Why is it still the same result...

steps.speaker: Jessie
steps.content: There's still a way... There must be a way... I can still do something... Just you wait...
Jessie slumps to the ground in defeat, muttering to herself as she desperately searches through the wreckage for fragments of her inventions.
Enough, Jessie, it's all over.
The sheriffs will be here soon, and you'll pay for what you've done.

Things have come to a close. The sheriffs who arrive take Jessie away. Some stay behind to clean up the Mania-tainted machine parts, which have been mostly destroyed in the recent fight. Only a few remain in the ruins, tightly guarded.
No longer in her sharp and agile combat mode, Eureka reverts back to her usual absent-minded self, muttering to herself as she stares blankly ahead.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Oh my, I've blown up this place for the second time... The cat hole is gone. The automatic stirring feeding bowl is also broken... What a pity. I was planning to take it back for the pets at the Bureau...
It's indeed a pity... but a bit of damage shouldn't be an obstacle for you, right?
You carefully pick out the fragments of the porcelain bowl buried in the sand, put them all into a plastic bag, and hand it to Eureka.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...Ch... Chief? What do you mean...?
Hmm... maybe you could try fixing it and then upgrade it when we get back?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Ah, I got it! I'll add automatic cooking, heating, and cooling functions to it! That way, the pets can eat food that suits their taste at any time!
Great idea! Genius inventor Eureka's new invention will surely be a hit at the MBCC!
In response to your praise, Eureka scratches her head and smiles somewhat bashfully.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Th... thank you, Chief... but I'm just a terrible inventor who has caused a lot of trouble for everyone...

Really? But the person who found Jessie, cracked all her dangerous weapons, defeated her, and successfully confiscated those dangerous Mania-tainted parts, is you. Don't always be so modest. You are the most amazing inventor I have ever met.

steps.speaker: Mini Robot
steps.content: Clack! A complete victory! Cheering for you! Clack clack clack! Great inventor! Eureka!
The familiar clacking sound comes from Eureka's toolkit, continuing your words on its own.
It can talk!?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Huh? I don't know... Let me see...
Eureka looks around in bewilderment, holding the small robot at eye level with both hands.

The setting sun's afterglow envelops the bombed-out factory. She gently gazes at the little robot she created, softly stroking its smooth head, treating it with love and awe as if it were a living creature.
Here, is rebirth. The creator here is...
Eureka, the "terrible inventor."
